sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast. My name is Emily. Today we will talk about Jaipur.
Jaipur is a famous city in India. It is the capital city of the state Rajasthan. Many people
around the world know Jaipur as the pink city. Let's learn about this beautiful and historic
place in slow and easy English. Where is Jaipur? Jaipur is in the north of India.
It is about 280 kilometers from Delhi, the capital of India. The city is near the Arabali hills.
It is also part of the Golden Triangle. The Golden Triangle is a travel route with three cities.
Delhi, Agra and Jaipur. Many tourists visit these three cities together.
Why is Jaipur called the pink city? Jaipur is called the pink city because many buildings are
painted pink. In 1876 the king of Jaipur wanted to welcome a special guest. The guest was a prince
from England. The king decided to paint the city pink, the color of hospitality. Since then,
Jaipur has kept the pink color. It makes the city look warm, beautiful and unique.
What can we see in Jaipur? Jaipur has many famous landmarks. Amber Fort, a big fort on a hill with
palaces, courtyards and gardens. City Palace, the royal home of the kings of Jaipur.
Hawa Mahal or Palace of Winds. It has 953 small windows for the royal ladies to look outside.
Jontar Montar, an old place for astronomy. It has large instruments to study the sun and stars.
Jaipur Mahal or Water Palace. It stands in the middle of a lake and it looks magical at sunset.
These places show the history and culture of Rajasthan. How many people live in Jaipur?
About 4 million people live in Jaipur. It is a busy city but also full of tradition.
Most people speak Hindi. Some also speak Rajasthan languages.
English is common too, especially in schools and with tourists.
What is daily life like in Jaipur? Many people in Jaipur live in colorful houses.
They go to markets called bazaars to shop for food, clothes and jewelry.
The bazaars are full of colors, sounds and smells. You can see people selling spices,
fabrics and sweets. Life in Jaipur is a mix of modern and traditional.
There are busy roads with cars and motorbikes but also camel carts and rickshaws.
What is Jaipur famous for? Jaipur is famous for jewels and gemstones. Many people buy rings,
necklaces and bracelets here. Handmade carpets and textiles. Very colorful and beautiful.
Traditional clothes like saris and turbines. Block printing. A special way of making designs
on fabric. Tourists love to buy souvenirs from Jaipur's markets. What do people eat in Jaipur?
The food in Jaipur is part of Rajasthani cuisine. It is full of spices and flavors.
Popular dishes are dalbati churma, lentils with baked bread and sweet crumbs,
gatiki sabzi, groundflower dumplings and a curry sauce,
carisangri, a desert bean and berry dish, sweets like gewar and ladoos. People also drink masala
chai or spice tea every day. Festivals in Jaipur. Jaipur loves to celebrate festivals.
The kite festival in January fills the sky with colorful kites. The elephant festival in March
shows elephants decorated with paint and jewelry. The teach festival celebrates the rainy season
with music and dancing. During festivals, people wear bright clothes, sing songs and share food.
Fun facts about Jaipur. Jaipur was founded in 1727 by Maharaja Sawai Jaip Singh II.
It was one of the first planned cities in India with straight roads and squares.
In 2019, Jaipur became a UNESCO World Heritage City. Many Bollywood movies are filmed in Jaipur's
palaces and forts. Now you know about Jaipur. You learned why it is called the pink city.
